A1.justification: Both PDFs describe LeanGaussian and support reliable comparison. The complete main text and appendices, including equations, nine tables and twelve figures, can be matched despite reformatting.

before.justification: Section 4 and Appendix A.3 report original novel-view synthesis experiments, quantitative comparisons, ablations and timing measurements on ShapeNet-SRN and GSO.

after.justification: v3 retains the original benchmark results, ablations, timing measurements and qualitative evaluations in Section 4 and Appendix A.3.

M1.justification: Both versions retain UNet/DINOv2 feature fusion, random queries, projected Gaussian centers, deformable attention, iterative refinement and the same training losses. Figure 2's revised labels do not establish a procedural change.

E1.justification: Both use ShapeNet-SRN cars and chairs, Objaverse-LVIS training with GSO evaluation, and the same in-the-wild examples. Distant-view evaluation scenarios are also retained.

E2.justification: Comparator membership matches across the corresponding tables and figures, including Hierarchical Splatter Image in Table 2, TripoSR in Table 9, and the appendix comparisons with Gamba, LGM and InstantMesh.

E3.justification: Dataset splits, image resolution, training schedules, PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS metrics and A100 timing procedures remain unchanged. Both retain the GSO angular exclusion criterion and the ShapeNet neighboring-view exclusion experiment.

E4.justification: Both retain component ablations in Tables 5 and 7, neighboring-view analyses in Tables 3 and 6, opacity-filtered point clouds in Figure 10, and Gaussian-count and decoder-layer analyses in Figure 12.

E5.justification: Appendix A.2 in both versions states that inference uses different random seeds and quantitative results report means of ten experiments. Neither introduces additional uncertainty statistics or changes this reporting practice.

E6.justification: Tables 1–9 and the experimental figures retain their results. Table 1 still reports 22.36 GSO PSNR, Table 2 reports 25.00/25.87 for cars/chairs, and Appendix Table 9 reports 23.45. The differing GSO values across tables already occur in v2.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, assumptions and Equations 1–7 retain the same Gaussian parameterization, rendering, attention and loss formulations. Changes to matrix brackets and equation layout are typographical.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions concerning direct Gaussian modeling and projected reference points. Benchmark superiority claims and the stated 7.2 FPS reconstruction and 500 FPS rendering speeds remain unchanged.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning redundant Gaussians, input-view shortcuts and performance–efficiency trade-offs are retained. Section 5 repeats the same limitations involving unseen textures and self-occluded regions.

D1.justification: The abstract replaces a promised future code release under DIG3D with stated availability at the LeanGaussian repository. Implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware and training times in Appendix A.2 remain unchanged. Actual repository availability cannot be verified from the PDFs.

R1.justification: Both retain the same 59 cited works and research positioning. Grounding DINO and Stable-DINO exchange reference numbers 30 and 31; citation sorting and added bibliography back-references do not change the cited research.

P1.justification: v3 makes limited wording corrections and revises author, affiliation and contribution information, adding Yuan Yao and an equal-contribution note. Cross-reference conventions change, while section order and substantive prose remain essentially intact.

P2.justification: The main text and appendix undergo extensive conversion from single-column to two-column layout, with widespread resizing and relocation of figures and tables. Figures 4–5 and 8–9 become column-sized, Figure 2 gains explicit Gaussian/refinement/rendering labels, and placeholder running headers disappear.

improvement.justification: v3 replaces a future code-release promise with stated access and clarifies the Gaussian and rendering stages in Figure 2. These changes and removal of placeholder headers modestly improve reproducibility guidance and presentation. The gain is limited: scientific evidence is unchanged, some qualitative figures are smaller, and repository contents cannot be verified from the PDFs.
